name: ILR10 construction stormwater inspections + BMP maintenance for Chicagoland site contractors, homebuilders and public owners
summary: Customer unit = one active ILR10-covered construction site under a per-site monthly contract for 7-day and post-0.5-inch-storm inspections, signed reports and corrective-action tickets, with BMP repair/maintenance (inlet filters, silt fence, construction entrance, ditch checks) billed on a T&M/unit basis and averaged into ARPC. Founder inspects the first ~15 sites (after the free USEPA CGP inspector course and, later, CESSWI); inspectors are hired at ~25 sites each (storm-trigger cap). Winter months drop to monthly inspections where work stops for frozen conditions; seasonality is averaged into ARPC because the engine has no seasonal driver.
evidence_notes: Mandate: ILR10 inspections every 7 calendar days and within 24 hours / next business day of a 0.5-inch storm by qualified personnel the permittee provides; monthly in frozen shutdowns [A, C7-S011]. EPA CGP inspector course is free and passing it qualifies a person [A, DB-S010]; CESSWI costs $370 + $345, renewal $160/yr [B, DB-S011]. GCs may self-inspect as 'knowledgeable persons' [A, C7-S011].

Demand: 5,341 effective ILR10 coverages; new coverages by effective year 1,007 (2023), 1,306 (2024), 1,503 (2025), 1,525 (2026 to 28 Nov); Chicagoland ZIP3 600-608 = 1,582 coverages effective 2025-26 under 957 permittee names [A, DB-S008]. 346 statewide permittees with 2+ sites hold 1,652 of 3,028 2025-26 coverages (repeat buyers). 'TBD' operator on 306 statewide coverages (owner filed before choosing a contractor).

Price evidence is thin: $95/inspection vendor proposal (NM) [D, C7-S014]; Fort Wayne municipal $1,440 for six monthly inspections (~$240) [B proxy, C7-S013]; Kane-DuPage SWCD charges developers $690/yr for oversight inspections on 0-9 acre sites (at least monthly + after significant rain) and $95/h non-compliance [A, DB-S009] - a public cost-recovery floor, not a private weekly price. No Illinois private per-inspection price found (MISSING).
Labour: specialist SWPPP firm pays inspectors ~$25-28 per inspection [D, C7-S016]; BLS wages not retrievable (API limit).

BMP pull-through prices (IDOT Aug-2022 letting awards): perimeter erosion barrier $1.93-$8.80/ft; inlet filters $61.60-$176 each; temporary ditch checks $8.80-$25/ft; stabilized construction entrance $70/sq yd; temporary sediment basin $2,500 [A, DB-S012] (public-contract installation prices, 2022).
Seasonality, win rates, share of GCs that outsource, and site lifetimes are E.

drivers.sales_start_delay_months__source: Free online EPA course qualifies [A, DB-S010]; GL/E&O policy and report templates (E).
drivers.sales_cycle_months__source: Contracted at mobilisation; NOI appears in ECHO near start (E).
drivers.founder_ramp_months__source: Credibility with site superintendents builds slowly; first season (E).
drivers.founder_leads_per_month__source: ~69 new Chicagoland ILR10 coverages per month in 2025-26 [A, DB-S008]; founder qualifies a fraction (E).
drivers.lead_to_proposal_pct__source: Many permittees already bundle inspections with the SWPPP engineer or self-inspect (E).
drivers.referral_new_per_100_active__source: Repeat sites from existing clients: 55% of 2025-26 coverages belong to permittees with 2+ sites [A, DB-S008]; rate per active site E.
drivers.monthly_churn_pct__source: Sites end at stabilisation/NOT; average coverage life ~11-17 months assumed (E). ECHO counts include stale coverages, so life is not directly observable [A caveat, C7-S012].
drivers.arpc_monthly__source: Inspection: ~45 inspections/site-yr (8 active months x ~5 incl. storm + 4 winter months x ~1.25) x $110/$130/$150 = $412/$487/$562 per site-month [D, C7-S013/S014; DB-S009 floor]; plus BMP maintenance averaging ~$10/$75/$120 per site-month (E, priced from IDOT unit awards [A, DB-S012]).
drivers.onetime_revenue_per_new_customer__source: Site set-up visit, SWPPP map/amendment, NOT support on a minority of sites (E). NOI state fee $250/$750 is the permittee's [A, WS15-S028].
drivers.gross_margin_pct__source: Direct costs: mileage ~$15-25 per visit, report software per site, BMP materials (inlet filters, fence) - labour is in Staff (E).
drivers.dso_days__source: Net 30-60 from GCs/builders (Stage C, E); municipal owners pay on board cycles.

staff.role: Field stormwater inspector (EPA CGP-trained; CESSWI within 12 mo)
staff.notes: ~$50-55k + burden + vehicle allowance ~$600/mo; ~25 sites per inspector because one 0.5-inch storm triggers every site within ~1 business day (Stage C). Silver Leaf pays $25-28/inspection [D, C7-S016]. Founder covers first 15 sites.
Non-union landscape/erosion laborer (E); public jobs would require prevailing wage - Cook laborer $53.00 + fringes [A, DB-S004].

overhead.notes: Premiums MISSING for Illinois stormwater inspectors (E); Insureon small-contractor medians ~$88/mo GL, $67/mo professional, $268/mo auto [D, DB-S007].

overhead.item: Inspection app, weather alerts, Claude seat, cloud storage
overhead.notes: Claude Pro/Team $20-25/seat [B, DB-S022]; inspection/forms app and rain-gauge alerts (E).

capex.item: Tablet, rain gauge, PPE, camera, CESSWI application+exam
